sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract, as such long-term commitments reflect the strong partnership we have built over the years.
While we note your should-cost estimate, our actual operational costs—particularly the recent wage increases—must be covered to ensure the continued quality of our castings.
In return for the extended contract duration, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.00 per unit.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
To help bridge the remaining gap, we are prepared to make a further concession and lower our price to €50.20 per unit.
We trust this fair compromise reflects our long-standing partnership and allows us to move forward.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with our valued partners in the region. We appreciate your continued movement and are willing to take another step towards your position. To bring us closer to a final agreement, we can offer a price of €49.30 per unit for the 24-month contract. This brings us very close to an agreement that honors our long-standing partnership.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. As a summary of our Angebot, we are offering a price of €49.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

My family and our craftsmen value the deep trust we have built together over the years, and we look forward to continuing our work alongside Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
